notes: מַבְלִיגִיתִי is recast as a full optative clause; the supplied frame stays with the noun, which carries the lexeme rendered 'comfort', and the competing reading that would mark parts of the frame added is named in the unit note.
The suffix is realized twice, as subject 'I' and reflexive 'myself', and both belong to its one discontinuous unit headed on the direct pronoun (rule 18).
The two עַל are separately rendered as 'against' and 'within', and the verbless clause's copula joins the predicate adjective דַוָּי under rule 20.
